## Professional facts

- Positioning: Senior Frontend / Full Stack Engineer (React, Angular, TypeScript, Python).
- Current role: Senior Software Engineer, Digital Twin, at Bosch Global Software Technologies (January 2023 to present, Bengaluru).
- Location: Coimbatore, India. Open to Coimbatore, Bengaluru, and remote.
- Leads a team of 8 frontend and 2 iOS developers, and mentored 4 UX interns.
- Digital Twin work covers 180 IoT assets, React and Angular frontends, 3D views, and maps (ArcGIS Maps SDK, Leaflet, Mapbox, OpenLayers) with live tracking, geofences, and drilldown markers. Data loads on demand. WebSockets are for the live-tracking cases.
- Python: FastAPI, Django, and Flask, including a backend-for-frontend and Teams bot integrations.
- Angular: 12, 16, and 18.
- Education: M.E. Information Technology, PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore, 2018 to 2020. B.E. Computer Science and Engineering, Jansons Institute of Technology, Coimbatore, 2013 to 2017.
